# Prospecting Skill for Muse

Turns an ICP definition into a verified, scored, ready-to-outreach prospect list across four branches: B2B SaaS (ICP fit, tech-stack match, funding/hiring/growth signals), general B2B (industry, size, geography, buying triggers), local small businesses (Google Maps-based research, website status, proximity, decision-maker access), and demand-signal discovery (your first customers from public pain signals — forums, reviews, GitHub issues, job posts, launches). Every engagement follows five phases: define the ICP as pass/fail criteria, over-source candidates (2–3× the target count), qualify each with evidence (two independent sources for high confidence), score Hot/Warm/Cold/Skip with a ~20/30 target split, and ship a lead sheet with sources, confidence, and last-verified dates — 25 verified leads beat 250 junk ones. Built-in compliance guardrails: no bulk scraping, no CAPTCHA or login-wall bypasses, public business contact channels only, GDPR/CAN-SPAM/CASL awareness with source URLs and dates captured per contact, no breached or unprovenanced data, no sensitive-trait targeting. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: sources like Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, and Clay are referenced but optional — free sources plus browser research work; list quality scales with the tools you actually have, and outreach compliance stays your responsibility. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
